question: Define the term boiling point.
memo: The temperature of the liquid at which the vapour pressure equals the external ( atmospheric) pressure. /Die temperatuur van die vloeistof waarteen die dampdruk aan die eksterne (atmosferiese) druk gelyk is.
final_answer: The temperature at which the vapour pressure equals atmospheric pressure.
